text: Android: no database transactions, so a sync merge can silently overwrite a concurrent edit

Landed in 304a9c7. New RoomDatabase.inTransaction built on useWriterConnection+immediateTransaction — Room's own withTransaction cannot be used here because it needs the SupportSQLite path while every test opens the DB with BundledSQLiteDriver (a new instance of the AGENTS.md Room-driver family; the rationale is in the file's KDoc). One transaction per row in the sync merge, never across a network call; repos now take AppDb. Two concurrency tests with real threads, both mutation-checked.
